turns.text: From the whole product catalogue: the margin of a SKU is (price - unit cost) / price. Which category has the lowest average margin, what is that average (in percent, 2 decimals), and how many SKUs in all have a margin under 40%?
turns.answer:
**Accessories** has the lowest average margin: **52.57%**.

- Average margin for each category is the mean of (price − unit cost) / price across its SKUs. Accessories is the lowest of the eight categories; the next lowest, outerwear, is 53.05%.
- **104 SKUs** in the catalogue (of 2,000) have a margin under 40%.

turns.text: Prepare a quarterly review of denim: Q2 and Q3 2026 revenue and the growth in percent; the top denim SKU of Q3 by revenue, its supplier and that supplier's on-time rate; how many stores sold denim in Q3; and denim's Q3 gross profit (revenue - units x unit cost).
turns.answer:
## Denim quarterly review: Q2 and Q3 2026

| Metric | Result |
|---|---|
| Q2 2026 denim revenue (Apr–Jun) | £638,896.78 |
| Q3 2026 denim revenue (Jul–Sep) | £784,850.47 |
| Growth, Q2 to Q3 | **+22.8%** (+£145,953.69) |
| Top denim SKU by Q3 revenue | **SKU-00741** (Stretch Skirt Navy): £98,411.00 |
| Its supplier | SUP-09 (Hanoi Mills) |
| SUP-09 on-time delivery rate | **98%** (supplier master, updated 2026-03-02) |
| Stores selling denim in Q3 | **40** |
| Q3 denim gross profit | **£414,078.20** |

**Gross profit:** Q3 revenue £784,850.47 minus units × unit cost of £370,772.27 (8,514 units across 242 SKUs) gives £414,078.20.

**Caveats:**
- Gross profit uses the current unit cost from the SKU catalogue, not the cost at the time of each sale. The catalogue has no historical costs, so if costs changed during Q3 this figure will be approximate.
- Revenue is after discounts, as the sales data reports it.
- "Denim" is the catalogue category `denim`, which covers jeans, jackets, shorts and skirts.
